title: attribution team config
description: Schema for a repository's docs/conventions/attribution.yaml, the team layer of the attribution plugin (ADR 0064, ADR 0075). The same keys are valid in docs/conventions/attribution.local.yaml (the personal layer) and in the user-global ~/.claude/attribution.json. Every key is optional; an absent key keeps the shipped default. Reader: skills/audit/scripts/lib.sh (cfg_scalar, cfg_list); judge_samples and the separation, accuracy, budgets.searches_per_candidate and budgets.fetches_per_candidate keys are read by the audit skill itself.

excluded_paths.description: Globs, matched against repo-relative paths, whose files the audit does not scan: a whole class of surface, never one passage. Replaces the lower layer's list whole; an empty list clears it. With no layer setting it, the bundled default declines test-fixture trees (**/fixtures/**, **/__fixtures__/**, **/testdata/**) below the scan target.

budgets.description: Caps that bound runaway source-search loops.

searches_per_candidate.description: Web searches allowed for one candidate; the shipped default is 3.

fetches_per_candidate.description: Page fetches allowed for one candidate; the shipped default is 5.

corpus_fetch_ceiling.description: Page fetches allowed across one whole run; the shipped default is 200.

separation.description: The deterministic separation rule's constants: it fires on containment at or above min_containment or a matched span at or above min_span_words, after quote-stripping.

min_containment.description: Containment ratio at or above which the rule fires; the shipped default is 0.3.

min_span_words.description: Matched-span length in words at or above which the rule fires; the shipped default is 15.

stamp_expiry_days.description: The verification-stamp expiry window in whole days; the shipped default is 180.

trigger_less_stamp_check.description: Flag a dated stamp whose surface states no recheck trigger; the shipped default is false.

judge_samples.description: Blind judges per candidate, a top-level key and never accuracy.judge_samples; the shipped default is 3, and a value below 3 is raised to 3 for any finding that could become fix-eligible and for every restated-fact panel.

gates.description: Fix-mode eligibility and release-readiness bars. They never filter what a report shows.

fix_precision_bar.description: Golden-set precision a class must reach to become fix-eligible; the shipped default is 0.95.

report_recall_floor.description: Golden-set recall a class must reach for release readiness; the shipped default is 0.8.

min_n_per_class.description: Golden cases a class must carry at or above the precision bar before it leaves report-only; the shipped default is 10.

nomination_passes.description: Nomination dispatches per run; the shipped default is 2.

judge_lens_diversity.description: Give each judge a different lens; the shipped default is true.

review_agents.description: Adversarial reviewers per copy-rubric STANDS verdict, 0 for none; the shipped default is 1.

deep_research_on_exhaustion.description: Let a budget-exhausted candidate escalate to /discovery:research when that plugin is installed; the shipped default is false.

verification.description: How much independent checking this plugin's skills run: off, light (the default: skip the verifier dispatch), standard (run it) or strict (also run the optional passes). Read from the default branch's committed copy only, so a branch cannot lower it. Levels: docs/contracts/verification-level/README.md.

verification_skills.description: Per-skill verification level, keyed by skill name (for example audit); an entry beats this file's verification value.
